source_bundle.purpose: Reuse only the already verified frozen source manifest and exact source identity; no V60 response is imported into the grammar artifact.

construction_contract: Verify the exact source bundle, catalog, V68 file hash, V68 self-hash, source manifest, and all 224 observation self-hashes.
Reject any row whose correct sentence, wrong sentence, split, prompt contract, or positive A/B and B/A margins differ from V68.
Create records for all search and validation rows, but permit only passing search rows to cross a later training-composition boundary.
Tokenize each selected correct sentence after construction with the authoritative frozen source tokenizer and label that count as posthoc contrastive selection, never as teacher generation.
Retain zero full source logits, zero activations, and zero source weights. Account the 896 selected log-probabilities and all ephemeral source-logit work from V68.
Expose exactly one available grammar inventory only if all locked validation thresholds pass.
The resulting .abix is teacher/source material and is never an installable LayerCake cake.
decision_rule: Construct once. Any identity, self-hash, tokenization, inventory, bundle verification, or accounting failure rejects V69 without invoking LayerCake.
failure_attribution: A V69 failure is ABI_ARTIFACT_CONSTRUCTION_FAILURE, never a LayerCake failure.
